summary: Phase 12 regression (frontend + backend-API spot checks) on packaged preview. Verified: (1) single-origin deployment — / renders marketing site (title 'Shree Ganesh Builders', site nav/Enquire/Call), /erp/login shows ERP login and admin@kkt.in / Kkt@12345 logs in → /erp/dashboard; deep-link reload on /erp/customers renders customers-grid; /portal/ renders Expo portal login, 9431012345 / Buyer@12345 signs in with POST to SAME origin /api/portal/auth/login then GET /api/portal/me|bookings|notifications/unread-count all succeed, reload keeps session on /portal/; zero console errors on each surface. (2) Operations reports — /erp/reports/service-sla has report-kpis + report-chart + report-status-counts + report-table + report-totals; /erp/reports/construction-progress has report-towers + chart + table with 5 'Now ·' pills; CSV export GET /api/reports/service-sla?format=csv → 200 (text/csv body), PDF GET /api/reports/construction-progress?format=pdf → 200 (10 KB PDF v1.4, 3 pages). (3) Touch kanban at 390 — sr-move-SR-2627-0004 opens sr-move-SR-2627-0004-menu with options ['In Progress','Awaiting Customer','Resolved','Closed']; moved New→In Progress then reverted In Progress→New (data pristine). Desktop keyboard at 1440 — focused sr-drag-SR-2627-0004, ArrowRight then ArrowLeft executed. (4) Customer 360 — opened Kavita Jha → profile-completeness='75%' → completeness-popover with missing links completeness-missing-locality|segments|preferences; clicking 'locality' navigates to /erp/customers/<id>/edit#address and section id='address' is in view (y=84). (5) Post Payment early cap — opened Post payment, picked BK-2526-0008 (Kavita Jha, SGH C-301), category=Cash: at amount=100 pp-cap small text 'Cash bucket: agreed ₹26,00,000 · received ₹2,60,000 · due now ₹0 · can accept up to ₹23,40,000' and Amount Field hint contains 'Room in this bucket: ₹…'; at amount=99999999 pp-cap turns error text ending 'Revise agreement first.', pp-revise-link present, pp-submit disabled=True. (6) Locality quick-add on /erp/customers/new — picked Bihar → Patna → opened sel-locality → typed 'QA Nagar' → 'Add "QA Nagar"' option appeared → clicked → sel-locality displays 'QA Nagar'; verified via GET /api/catalogues: types.locality contains {id, code:'QA_NAGAR', label:'QA Nagar', parent_id=<Patna id>}. (7) Keyboard — '?' opens shortcuts-sheet, Esc closes; 'g b' navigates to /erp/bookings; Ctrl+K opens command-palette-input. (8) Settings → Appearance — density-toggle present; clicking density-toggle-compact sets [data-density=compact] on AppShell, persists across reload, reset via density-toggle-comfortable. (9) No horizontal overflow at 390px on /erp/dashboard, /erp/customers, /erp/service-requests, /erp/reports/service-sla.

ui_bugs.issue: palette-action-new-booking and palette-action-post-payment DO NOT render for Super Admin — DOM only contains new-customer, new-lead, log-a-call, mark-construction-stage, roznamcha-today. ACTIONS in /app/frontend/src/components/common/CommandPalette.jsx L15-18 gates them on 'booking.write' and 'payment.write'; seeded admin role likely has booking.create / payment.post instead. Review request explicitly requires these palette items to exist and be selectable.

Already-seeded project opens on step 1 (Basics) and ALL other step buttons (step-2 … step-7) render disabled=true. User cannot jump directly to Pricing (step-6) to edit a per-tower 'Cash share % override' (price-<i>-cash); they'd have to Save & continue through 5 steps first. Blocks the Phase 12 'tower default_cash_percent override' workflow in practice.

issues: Error text concatenates with the link text, rendering as '…Revise agreement first.Revise agreement' (no space). Split 'Revise agreement first.' and the pp-revise-link child so DOM text has a separator.

action_items: FIX HIGH: CommandPalette ACTIONS permission codes — change 'booking.write'→'booking.create' (or whichever perm Super Admin actually has) and 'payment.write'→'payment.post' so New booking and Post payment items appear in ⌘K for admin/sales/accounts.

FIX HIGH: ProjectSetup Stepper should allow jumping to any step on an already-complete seeded project (step buttons currently disabled=true for 2..7). Either enable step pills when the step has data OR add a prominent 'Pricing' shortcut on the project detail page so the per-tower Cash share override is actually reachable without re-saving every earlier step.
MINOR UI: insert a space (or move 'Revise agreement' into a separate node) between 'Revise agreement first.' and the pp-revise-link so the sentence doesn't fuse with the link text.
critical_code_review_comments: Deployment package root-index SPA fallback with inline router-loader works correctly on all three surfaces (/, /erp/*, /portal/*) — same HTML served, loader selects shell based on pathname.
Portal auth goes to the same origin now (/api/portal/auth/login) — Phase 12 single-domain goal met.
Locality inline quick-add correctly POSTs and persists in catalogues under parent Patna with the catalogue permission gate (admin has catalogue.write).

CommandPalette ACTIONS perm codes do not match the role matrix in /app/memory/test_credentials.md (role perms: booking.create, payment.post/reverse). This is why admin loses two of the most important palette actions.
